hostname.description: Linux hostname. Source of truth is this object, not /etc/hostname.

power.description: run is steady state. reboot and halt require --confirm on apply.

env.description: Environment PID 1 puts in every svc spawn. Also written to root-owned /etc/profile for logins. Catalog is truth; /etc/profile is a side effect.

timezone.description: Local timezone (POSIX TZ string). Empty is UTC. Every svc and every login gets TZ from this unless env sets TZ. The system clock stays UTC.
